title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description: Most AI ‘engineers’ write strategies. This role builds the thing.LK Group is a multi-billion dollar group of portfolio companies — spanning the NBL, fashion, luxury property, premium retail, hospitality, and technology. We’ve just formed a dedicated group AI team with a clear mandate: move fast, build well, and create measurable value across our portfolio. This is the role that makes that happen, building.You’re not here to advise. You’re here to build & ship. If you thrive when you’re building real AI Agents & systems that go live and create outcomes — and you want to do that at scale, with autonomy, inside a group that genuinely backs its people — keep reading.About Us Few groups move as fast or think as broadly as LK Group. Our businesses range from the National Basketball League, to major retailers such as Brand Collective, Daniel’s Donuts, luxury property development, HR and recruitment, exciting digital and technology startups and many more.The Role As one of our AI Engineers, you’re a core member of the Group AI team, reporting to the GM - AI. Your job is to design, build, and deploy AI agents and automation pipelines that grow revenue & save real time across LK Group’s Support Team and Portfolio businesses.Day to day, you’ll be:Building and adding to internal software platforms, using LLM solutions such as Claude CodeDesigning and deploying AI agents natively within Anthropic’s Claude platformTesting agents against real business scenarios and resolving edge cases before they go liveMonitoring agent performance — reliability, latency, error rates — and keeping the standard highIntegrating AI services into existing business systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelinesBuilding and maintaining automated workflow pipelines using PowerAutoamte, n8n, Zapier, Make, and Shopify FlowBuilding and maintaining a library of reusable prompt templates, workflows, and system instructionsWriting clear technical documentationSupporting responsible AI practices across every build — data privacy, accuracy, and quality control embedded from the startThis is a founding role. The infrastructure you build will define how AI gets done across LK Group.Who We’re Looking For We want a builder — someone who comes alive when they’re building & shipping, thinks in pipelines and agents, and has the engineering rigour to make things reliable and built to last.You’re the right fit if you:Have had 3+ years experience in software developmentHave proven, hands-on experience building and deploying AI systems — what you’ve shipped matters more than how long you’ve been doing itHave production experience integrating large language models such as Claude (preferred), Gemma 4, Perplexity, LangChain or OpenClaw) into real applications — not just consumer or chat useAre experienced with prompt engineering and LLM configuration: system prompts, tool use, multi-step chains, and output evaluationHave built production workflows with PowerAutomate, n8n or equivalent — things that actually work in production, not just prototypesHave strong working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns, and data pipelinesExercise strong engineering judgement — you choose the right tool, scope builds pragmatically, and debug systematicallyHold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or have a portfolio that speaks for itselfAnd just as important — you bring these to work every day:Entrepreneurial energy - You move fast, back yourself, and don’t wait for perfect conditions to start building.Professional rigour - You hold yourself to a high standard. Documentation is clear, code is clean, and what you ship works.Genuine curiosity - You care about what’s possible with AI — not just what’s been done before and you bring that energy to every build.Clarity in communication - You make complex technical concepts accessible to non-technical stakeholders without losing precision.What’s on OfferA founding role with real scope — you’re shaping how AI gets built across an entire groupGenuine autonomy — a mandate to move fast, backed by a team that trusts you to executeExposure across a genuinely diverse portfolio of businesses — property, sport, retail, tech, and moreA newly formed Group AI team at the start of something significantFull-time, Monday to Friday — based at LK Group Head OfficeCompetitive salary package, commensurate with experienceReady to build something real?If you read this and felt it — apply. Send us your CV and tell us what you’ve built. Show more Show less

title: AI Agent Developer
description: Key ResponsibilitiesSolution Development: Design, architect, and implement AI Agent systems that automate or augment complex financial workflows, including trade support, market research synthesis, client communications, and data analysis.LLM Integration & Orchestration: Build and maintain multi-step agent pipelines leveraging frameworks such as Dify, or equivalent orchestration platforms. Integrate with Bloomberg API, internal data infrastructure, and third-party data providers to deliver domain-specific AI capabilities.Prompt Engineering: Develop, evaluate, and optimize structured prompts and agent instructions to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance-readiness in LLM-generated outputs across financial contexts.Rapid Prototyping & Validation: Translate business requirements into functional prototypes on compressed timelines. Validate solution feasibility through iterative testing with end users and subject matter experts.Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with traders, portfolio managers, distribution professionals, and compliance officers to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and ensure delivered solutions meet institutional quality standards.Production Transition: Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks to support handoff of validated solutions to the platform engineering team for production deployment and ongoing maintenance.Technology Evaluation: Monitor and assess emerging AI capabilities, tooling, and best practices. Provide structured recommendations to senior leadership on technology adoption and strategic direction.QualificationsBachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.Strong proficiency in Python; working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript is advantageous.Demonstrated experience with large language models, AI agent frameworks (AutoGen, CrewAI, Dify, or comparable), and prompt engineering methodologies.High proficiency with AI-assisted development environments including GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and GPT-based tooling.Excellent English communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and precise model instructions.Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities; ability to decompose complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, deliverable engineering tasks.Self-directed work style with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and deliver under time constraints.
